mission_audit.meaning: Exploration finished is a return-home trigger. Only mission COMPLETED confirms the home radius, low-speed and dwell checks; neither establishes ground-truth full coverage.

source_aligned_input_delivery.meaning: A constant offset supports no net relative input loss between the full-rate external observer and mapper in this matched window. It does not prove the simulator published continuously or that neither subscriber missed the same message.

limitations: One indoor run; not a real-vehicle safety guarantee.
A running node is not proof of exploration progress.
RSS sums can double-count shared pages. GPU total includes the desktop.
Probe ages and stop states are sampled1Hz and0.5s; full control messages retained in MCAP.
Reported planner runtime is not end-to-end latency.
